annotations.title: Holy ground.
annotations.text: [1] If that apparition of God him self or an Angel, could make the place and ground holy, and to be vsed of Moyses vvith al signes of reuerence and feare: [2] hovv much more the corporal birth, abode, and vvonders of the Sonne of God in Ievvrie, and his personal presence in the B. Sacrament, may make that countrie and al Christian Churches & altars holy? And it is the greatest blindnes that can be, to thinke it superstition to reuerence any things or places in respect of Gods presence or vvonderous operation in the same. See S. Hierom. ep. 17. 18. 27. of the holy land.

annotations.title: Not in houses.
annotations.text: The vulgar Heretikes alleage this place against the corporal being of Christ in the B. Sacrament & in Churches: by vvhich reason they might haue driuen him out of al houses, Churches, and corporal places, vvhen he vvas visible in earth. But it is meant of the Diuinitie only, & spoken to correct the carnal Ievves: <mn>◦</mn> Who thought God either so to be conteined, compassed, and limited to their Temple, that he could be no vvhere els, or at least that he vvould not heare or receiue mens praiers and sacrifices in the Churches of the Gentiles, or els vvhere, out of the said Temple. And so as it maketh nothing for the Sacramentaries, no more doth it serue for such as esteeme Churches and places of publike praier no more conuenient nor more holy then any other profane houses or chambers. For though his person or vertue be not limited to any place, yet it pleaseth him condescending to our necessitie and profite, to vvorke his vvonders and to be vvorshipped of vs in holy places rather then profane.

notes.text: God is not conteined in place, yet he vvil be vvorshipped in one place more then in an other.

annotations.title: They stoned him.
annotations.text: Read a marvelous narration in S. Augustine of one stone, that hitting the Martyr on the elbow, rebounded back to a faithful man that stood near. ◦ Who keeping and carrying it with him, was by revelation warned to leave it at Ancona in Italy: whereupon a Church or Memory of S. Steven was there erected, and many miracles done after the said Martyr's body was found out, and not before. Aug. to. 10. ser. 38. de diversis in edit. Paris.
